title: unified-rollouts: improve canary/AB/shadow autorollback workflow and stability guards
author: Sofia Martinez
description: Motivation: We observed instability in model rollouts when using mixed canary/A-B/shadow strategies under bursty traffic. Root cause analysis pointed to (1) race conditions in the autorollback decision path when multiple metrics flipped concurrently; (2) insufficient quorum logic for observability signals from shadow probes; and (3) lack of safety guards when model variants had mismatched tokenization/response-time tails. This PR centralizes and hardens the autorollback workflow for unified rollouts to improve safety and predictability. Implementation summary: 1) Refactor autorollback engine to a single deterministic state machine that accepts metric epochs rather than ad-hoc callbacks; 2) Add metric quorum and weighted scoring for shadow probes so a small noisy signal doesn't trigger rollbacks; 3) Introduce per-rollout stability window and transient-suppression heuristics to ignore short-lived spikes (configurable via rollout policy); 4) Add compatibility checks to detect tokenization/model-output schema mismatches early and halt rollout on detection; 5) Expose rollout decision telemetry to Console (per-rollout traces and token-level latency histograms) and add two new metrics used by auto-rollback: rollout_failure_score and shadow_probe_quorum. Backwards compatibility and config: Default behavior is unchanged for existing rollouts. New behavior is opt-in per-rollout via the rollout.policy field: {"autorollback_engine": "v2", "stability_window_seconds": 120, "shadow_quorum": 0.65}. The rollout controller will fall back to the v1 engine if a customer explicitly sets autorollback_engine: v1. Testing and validation: - Unit tests: expanded coverage for state transitions, quorum evaluation, and transient suppression. - Integration tests: new e2e suite that simulates canary+shadow traffic with controlled metric noise (tests/e2e/rollouts/test_shadow_canary.py). - Load tests: bench harnessed for mixed-traffic scenarios; observed 0 false-positive rollbacks in 1000 simulated noisy windows. Rollout and migration plan: We will roll this out as a staged feature flag. Phase 1: internal dogfood on staging with canary traffic (1w). Phase 2: opt-in beta for selected customers (2w). Phase 3: GA and default opt-in after monitoring (TBD). Safety: - Automatic quarantine: if quorum can't be reached for 3 consecutive epochs, the rollout is paused and flagged for manual review. - Manual override remains available via Console and API. - Added alerting: new alerts for high rollout_failure_score and shadow_probe_quorum_breach. CI and checks: All unit and integration tests pass. E2E and load tests were run in the performance lab; one flaky benchmark task required re-run and passed. Review summary and decisions: See review comments below. This PR is a squash-merged commit that contains the refactor, feature gates, telemetry, and docs. See changed files for details. Merge details: merged to main with squash merge after approvals and successful CI. Release notes: "Unified rollouts: safer autorollback engine (v2) with quorum-based shadow probing, stability windows, and improved telemetry. Opt-in via rollout.policy; no default behavior changes."

feat(rollouts): add shadow probe quorum & weighted scoring
feat(telemetry): expose rollout_failure_score and per-rollout traces
chore(docs): rollout policy docs and examples
review_comments: Ethan Chen: Please ensure the quorum default is conservative; a 0.65 default seems reasonable but document tradeoffs. Author reply: Agreed — set default to 0.65 and added notes in docs explaining tradeoffs.
Priya Kapoor: We should avoid long stability windows for low-traffic customers. Author reply: Added per-rollout config and controller will auto-tune if average QPS < 0.5 to reduce window to 30s.
Liam O'Connor: Can we get a dashboard for quick triage? Author reply: Added rollout traces and a perf dashboard with token latency tails; referenced dashboard in docs.
QA (internal): Found flake in e2e when probe sampling rate is low; Author reply: Added sampling guard and improved test harness to seed probe events deterministically.
Ethan Chen: Approved after CI green and documentation updates.
ci_checks: ci/perf/bench: pass (one flaky run re-run ok)
release_notes: Unified rollouts: introduce autorollback engine v2. Adds shadow probe quorum, stability windows, transient suppression heuristics, early model compatibility checks, and rollout decision telemetry. Opt-in via rollout.policy. Improves safety for canary/AB/shadow workflows with minimal default behavior change.
notes_for_changelog: Major: safer autorollback engine (v2) with quorum-based shadow probing and stability windows. Minor: telemetry and Console dashboard for rollouts. Opt-in feature flag; no automatic behavior change for existing customers.
short_summary: Hardens unified rollout autorollback logic with quorumed shadow probing, stability windows, and improved telemetry. Adds e2e tests and Console observability for safer canary/A-B/shadow deployments.
